description: This file defines the 'SimpleGenerator' class which implements the 'IStreamGenerator' interface for generating a stream of events. It configures a stream, generates events one by one up to a specified count, and creates batches of generated events.

classes.name: SimpleGenerator
classes.description: Implements a simple stream generator that produces a configurable number of events, one per poll.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the generator with provided service provider and generator configuration, initializes stream ID and sequence ID.

methods.name: TryReadEvents
methods.description: Attempts to generate and return a batch of events up to maxCount, until the configured number of events is reached.

methods.name: TryGenerateBatch
methods.description: Generates a single event batch if the number of events generated is less than total configured events.
